br_ranked.rule: If match score is negative due to elimination by an identified cheater, zero points are deducted. Excludes the 20 extra daily mission points.

cs_ranked.rule: If defeated by an identified cheater, zero rank stars and zero protection points are deducted.

honor_system_and_penalties.teammate_force_quit_compensation: Grants extra CS-Ranked protection points if a teammate force quits
